text:
Sam: Quick idea — mini sparkler toast in the kitchen at 4:30 on Friday? :tada:
Chloe: Love it. Low-key, 2 mins, ornaments off the plants, then back to work 😂
Alex: If by sparkler you mean those tiny cake sparklers, ok. Not full fireworks pls :grimacing:
Jordan: Count me in. I'll bring a box of those mini chocolate coins and napkins.
Maria: I'm on snack duty — will bring a tray of ginger lemon bars. Any allergy flags?
Sam: @Maria awesome. No peanuts in the office please (allergy flag).
Liam: Can we make it a tiny meme exchange too? Secretly put a meme under someone's cup. :smirk:
Chloe: 100% yes to memes. I'll make a small bingo card of holiday GIF categories and pin it.
Ops Bot: Reminder: Kitchen decor should not obstruct exits. Also please clean up after the toast. :robot_face:
Alex: Quick poll — react with :sparkler: if you're coming, :cookie: if you're only dropping snacks, :x: if nope.
Jordan: Done. Also, Sam can we keep it under 10 minutes? Some folks have end-of-day calls.
Sam: Yep, strict 10-min window. I'll set a calendar event for 4:25-4:35 with a quiet-doors note.
Maria: FYI I packed two gluten-free rows on the tray. Labelled.
Chloe: Meme exchange rules: no work screenshots, keep it safe-for-work, and bonus points for tacky holiday sweaters in the meme.
Liam: Bringing an absolutely ridiculous knitted reindeer hat as a prop. Photo op?
Alex: Photo op but no faces posted without consent. Quick thumbs-up in thread if it's ok to share pics in #random for the slideshow.
Jordan: Thumbs up from me.
Maria: thumbs up :thumbsup:
Sam: Thumbs up from me too.
Ops Bot: Note: please don't bring open flame items. Cake sparklers (small) are allowed per building rules when used responsibly.
Chloe: I'll draft a 2-line sign for the kitchen: "Mini Sparkler & Meme Pop-up — 4:30 Fri. 10-min toast, tidy up!"
Sam: Perfect. Thanks everyone — excited for the mini chaos and memes. :sparkles:
Liam: Also, kudos to Facilities for the twinkle lights already up — they look great :clap:
